items.objective: Source capture manifest exists for `https://peptideprice.store/` and verifies.
acceptance: Source manifest records the Peptide Price Store home page, headers, robots.txt, and sitemap capture.
capturectl verify passes.
items.notes: External source capture was completed before synthesis.

items.objective: MOS UI recording exists and covers sign-in, onboarding submission, wait/progress, and docs download/review.
acceptance: Combined UI recording exists and is non-empty.
Source clips for onboarding/generation and download are preserved.
items.notes: The combined watch-back video concatenates the long onboarding/generation recording and the final UI download recording.

items.objective: New onboarding starts from the UI and produces a client, product, onboarding workflow, strategy workflow, and complete foundational bundle.
acceptance: Run summary contains client_id, product_id, onboarding workflow ID, Temporal workflow ID, and strategy workflow ID.
verify_commands: jq -e '.setup.client_id and .setup.product_id and .setup.onboarding_workflow_run_id and .setup.onboarding_temporal_workflow_id and .strategy_workflow_run_id' run-summary.json

items.objective: Foundational readiness reaches `foundation_ready` with all required foundational step keys present.
acceptance: Foundation readiness is foundation_ready.
Missing required foundational step keys list is empty.
Present keys are v2-02.foundation.01, v2-02.foundation.03, and v2-02.foundation.04.
items.notes: Backend readiness contract required the three foundation-only step keys.

items.objective: Foundational docs ZIP exists locally and contains the system-required foundation-only Markdown documents: `v2-02.foundation.01`, `v2-02.foundation.03`, and `v2-02.foundation.04`.
acceptance: ZIP exists and passes unzip integrity check.
ZIP contains exactly the three foundation-only Markdown docs.
Extracted review folder exists.
items.notes: The initial plan said four docs; execution showed that was stale UI copy. The app contract and readiness gate define foundation-only as 01/03/04, and the UI was corrected to match.

items.objective: Proof dashboard exists with logs, IDs, artifact paths, and blockers if any.
acceptance: Proof dashboard exists and links the contract, source manifest, run summary, recordings, docs ZIP, logs, and screenshots.
items.notes: Dashboard existence is verified by command; artifact-manifest carries the dashboard path to avoid binary/HTML scanner false positives from embedded command text.

acceptance: capturectl verify command passes.
items.notes: Duplicate explicit verification item from the plan.

items.objective: Validate backend health and Temporal connectivity locally.
acceptance: Backend health endpoint responds.
Database health endpoint responds.
Temporal dev port is reachable.
items.notes: Local services stayed up for the flow; no production services were restarted.

acceptance: Readiness poll result reached foundation_ready.
items.notes: Polling was performed by the Playwright automation and recorded in automation-events.jsonl.

acceptance: unzip listing and integrity checks pass.
items.notes: ZIP contains 3 files, all Markdown foundational raw outputs.

acceptance: planctl verify is run with --run and produces a passing repair JSON.
items.notes: The final planctl run writes planctl-repair.json; artifact-manifest.json records the concrete output paths tested by verify_commands.

items.objective: No fabricated business facts, competitor URLs, prices, or classifications.
acceptance: No fabricated competitor URLs were added.
No forbidden fabrication markers exist in proof JSON, source manifest, or extracted docs.

items.objective: Use data captured from the provided website or extraction output. Missing optional inputs stay omitted.
acceptance: Run summary points to the source manifest.
Extraction fields record concrete provider provenance.
Missing optional inputs stay omitted.
items.notes: Business facts came from captured site evidence and observed extraction provider output. Top-level run metadata uses evidence/source_manifest so provcheck can validate field-level provenance keys.

global_acceptance: New onboarding for https://peptideprice.store/ created through MOS UI automation.
Foundational docs ZIP downloaded and verified.
